title: Python FragmentSender cannot consume authenticated abort controls
description: SchcSessionManager.record_verified_frame parses every authenticated response as Ack, so canonical Sender-Abort 78fe and Receiver-Abort 78ffff never become pending evidence; transition_ack has no abort branch. An active FragmentSender cannot stop timers, release state, report failure, or enter terminal hold-down on an authenticated peer abort as required by the spec. Add typed authenticated control admission and terminal transitions for aborts with signer/target/generation/replay binding, plus forged/wrong-session/duplicate/timeout race tests and shared vectors.
notes: Independent rereview found stale/unsolicited canonical ACK could fall through into reassembly and elicit Receiver-Abort instead of silent discard. Fixed with regression.
